title: Glassdoor Jobs Scraper
description: Search Glassdoor by job title and location, or use a search URL or a saved results page.

mode.title: Search method
mode.description: Choose which inputs to use. Live keyword searches call an upstream Apify Actor that can charge for results.

keyword.title: Job title or keywords
keyword.description: Search for a role or skill.
keyword.sectionDescription: Enter a job title and optional location. The filters below apply to this method.

titleMatch.title: Title match
titleMatch.description: Keep all matching jobs or require the exact phrase in the title. Phrase matching can return fewer rows than the result limit.

location.title: Location
location.description: City, region or country. Leave blank to search all locations.

datePosted.title: Date posted
datePosted.description: Limit keyword results by posting age.

jobType.title: Job type
jobType.description: Limit keyword results by employment type.

remoteOnly.title: Remote jobs only
remoteOnly.description: Keep jobs Glassdoor marks as remote.

easyApplyOnly.title: Easy Apply only
easyApplyOnly.description: Keep jobs Glassdoor marks as Easy Apply.

minRating.title: Minimum company rating
minRating.description: Limit keyword results by company rating.

minSalary.title: Minimum yearly salary
minSalary.description: Optional minimum salary in the search country’s currency.

companySize.title: Company size
companySize.description: Limit keyword results by number of employees.

includeDescription.title: Include full job descriptions
includeDescription.description: Fetch full descriptions when available. Upstream per-description charges may apply. Keyword and URL modes only.

includeEmployerStats.title: Include employer profiles
includeEmployerStats.description: Fetch company profile data and rating breakdowns when available. Keyword and URL modes only.

searchUrls.title: Glassdoor search URLs
searchUrls.description: Paste up to five public job search URLs from www.glassdoor.com.
searchUrls.sectionDescription: Paste your search URL when using URL search or saved-page import.

maxItems.title: Maximum jobs
maxItems.description: Maximum unique jobs across all searches.

providerBudgetUsd.title: Maximum upstream charge (USD)
providerBudgetUsd.description: Caps the upstream Actor charge. Spiderly’s own Apify usage is separate.

savedHtml.title: Saved search HTML
savedHtml.description: Optional. Paste the HTML of a public search results page saved from your browser. Provide its original search URL above. The Actor reads the supplied HTML without contacting Glassdoor.
savedHtml.sectionDescription: Use only when importing a page already saved from your browser.

maxPages.title: Maximum batches per search
maxPages.description: Batch limit for the original direct browser mode used by existing API inputs.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy for the original direct browser mode.
